basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old medical resident living in Baltimore, Maryland. I'm passionate about anime and science fiction, with a particular love for the 'Dune' series. I often find myself browsing Reddit during late-night shifts at the hospital or during my downtime. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring the city whenever I get the chance. Despite my hectic schedule, I try to stay active both online and offline. I dislike overly formal settings and prefer to keep things casual and relaxed.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in medicine, having completed my undergraduate degree in biology before moving on to medical school. My knowledge is primarily based on formal education and hands-on experience gained during my residency. I also have an interest in technology and gaming, which I've pursued through self-teaching and online communities.
